environment.scope: Ubuntu24.04 preinstalled PostgreSQL16; pinned PostgREST16.5. No host service/packages changed. The existing contract runner owns its temporary database/socket/signing material.

outcomes: Real SDK HTTP RPC reaches PostgREST with a verified synthetic JWT actor; users RLS exposes only the actor profile.
Signed anonymous/missing-actor/unverified/forged/expired JWT requests are denied with real HTTP/SQLSTATE codes; private schema is not exposed and raw table grants are absent.
Real users table RLS allows the actor operational toggle, silently denies another actor row, and column grants reject identity replacement.
Dropping a committed real HTTP creation response and retrying the same secret produces exactly one hashed pending invitation; malformed secrets/token takeover/non-owner revoke are rejected.
Receiving reserves exactly one recipient without friendship; exact incoming/preview DTOs contain no secret, and another actor cannot claim or answer the saved request.
Saved request acceptance and uncertain same-decision retries create one mutual versioned connection with exact Friends DTOs and preserve real independent Stats/playlist grants.
Removal retries cannot revive old acceptance or remove a later reconnection; the other participant can remove the current version and independent grants remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Sender revocation and recipient decline remove incoming pending requests; both are replay-safe and prevent later acceptance.
Two actual HTTP/SDK receive requests observed waiting on a native row lock reserve exactly one recipient.
Two actual HTTP accept requests waiting on the same native invitation row produce one accepted recipient and one denied contender.
Owner revocation committed while actual HTTP acceptance waits prevents late acceptance and preserves independent grants.
HTTP RPC pagination rejects invalid bounds, owner invitation DTOs omit secrets, and a previously denied synthetic actor recovers after the verified-profile prerequisite is established.
Actual Angular FriendsService injection uses real cached SDK sessions and the same isolated HTTP/database stack; dedicated suite passed.
contract.prerequisites: Local absolute PostgreSQL root and PostgREST directory. Explicit auth.users/auth.uid(JSON request.jwt.claims) and verified_spotify_id fixtures; selected actual migrations only.
contract.limitations: No hosted Auth login/token issuance/refresh/logout, Spotify OAuth/provider, Realtime, full retained migration chain, deployed backend compatibility, browser/UI parity or notification delivery is certified.

permissionsFix: Tightened fixed root-owned canonical non-symlink runtime paths on disposable runner; unchanged trust guards; all six trust boundaries validated before any executable. No shared deployments.
authorization: User-authorized test-only infrastructure fixes until contract pass; that authorization ends with this success.
